model_output.score_comment_short: Branch size and deposit growth are clear, while several responsibilities need more detail.
model_output.score_comment_long: The branch manager role includes a deposit result and an employee count. Audit oversight and customer escalations are less specific. Explaining the work behind those bullets would make the role easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: Your resume gives a reviewer a clear reason to consider you for branch management roles. It leaves questions about how you handled compliance and customer issues.
model_output.first_impression: Your most recent role was managing an 11-employee bank branch, following assistant manager and personal banker positions at the same bank. The progression is easy to follow, though much of the work is described in brief duties.

model_output.summary: Growing branch deposits from $48M to $63M over five years gives your management role a concrete business result worth keeping prominent. Your career at Magnolia Community Bank moves from customer accounts and loans into branch supervision and management. The most recent title and responsibilities point to branch manager level. How you contributed to the deposit growth is not described, so a reviewer cannot see which actions accompanied that result.
strengths: Managing 11 employees gives the branch manager title a clear team context.
Weekly sales huddles and referral coaching show how you worked with bankers, rather than simply listing supervision.
Teller line and vault supervision in the assistant manager role adds operational breadth to your banking background.
gaps: The resume does not explain your role in deposit growth beyond the result, leaving your approach to building deposits unclear.
Audit and compliance oversight is named without the reviews or follow-up you handled, making the work difficult to distinguish from general supervision.
The complaint bullet does not identify the issues escalated to you or the decisions you could make, so your customer-resolution authority remains unclear.
